name: Side Plank
sourceScope: Candidate: one intact retained raised forearm side-plank hold, six separate paths with honest repeated form-focus beats. No illustrated rise/lower/switch or six physical states claimed. No new image requests or human geometry edits.
setup: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet (or stagger for easier) and brace your core.
Lift your hips off the floor into a straight line from head to feet.
catalogueInstructionsUnchanged: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet (or stagger for easier) and brace your core.
Lift your hips off the floor into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold for time, breathing normally, then switch sides.
afterHold: Hold for time, breathing normally, then switch sides.

beats.label: Support
beats.cue: Keep your elbow beneath your shoulder.

beats.label: Stack
beats.cue: Keep your feet stacked and steady.

beats.label: Align
beats.cue: Keep head, hips and feet aligned.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Keep your hips raised and core braced.

beats.label: Breathe
beats.cue: Breathe normally without dropping your hips.

beats.label: Time
beats.cue: Hold for time; then repeat opposite side.
